cbus.fry
Class Session

java.lang.Object
  cbus.fry.Session
All Implemented Interfaces:
Session
public class Session
extends java.lang.Object
implements Session

The session class stablishes a simple contract to access publish/subscribe middleware. It mimics the delegation event model to smooth the transition from local to remote events for Java programmers
